title: tectaria aurita
intro: Tectaria aurita, commonly known as the auriculated tectaria or the auriculated shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria aurita include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
